sessions.charter: Explore the dark appearance across product, basket and checkout pages with preference, consistency, keyboard and assistive-technology checks to discover unreadable surfaces or regressions.
notes: Product listing, product details, basket and checkout all used the dark page, header, card and form colors.
Keyboard focus reached the skip link, and the accessibility snapshot retained the expected page headings, links, controls and status messages.
Adding Tinfoil Thinking Cap updated the basket count and live status; basket total was $12.50; checkout completed and cleared the basket.
The first dark basket view showed low-contrast secondary button labels. After the fix, the labels were light on the dark button surfaces.
No browser console errors were reported on the visited pages.

sessions.charter: Explore the unchanged light appearance and mobile layout with light and dark device preferences to discover unintended light-mode or narrow-screen changes.
notes: At 320px wide, the product listing remained within the viewport without visible horizontal overflow.
The light preference retained the original pink-blue header gradient, light page background and white product cards.
Changing the emulated preference from light to dark updated the page colors without reloading.

findings.title: Secondary basket button labels lacked contrast in dark appearance
steps: Set the device color scheme to dark.
Add a product and open the basket.
Inspect the Remove and Clear All Products controls.
findings.expected: Secondary button labels remain readable against their dark surfaces.
findings.actual: The secondary button text used the dark primary-button text color and was difficult to read against the dark surface.
findings.resolution: Set secondary button text to the theme ink color, which is light in dark mode and unchanged in light mode. Retested with a targeted E2E assertion and a Playwright CLI basket check; the labels are readable and the page reports no console errors.

notExplored: Non-Chromium browser rendering and native scrollbar appearance.
